classdef.name: ConditionSet
classdef.shortdesc: A condition set for conditional text.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the ConditionSet.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the ConditionSet (a Application or Document).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the ConditionSet within its containing object.

property.name: setConditions
property.shortdesc: List of conditions and visibilities in the set. Can return: Ordered array containing condition:Condition, visibility:Boolean.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: remove
method.shortdesc: Delete a condition set for conditional text.

parameter.name: replacingWith
parameter.shortdesc: The condition set to apply to the text in place of the deleted condition set. By default, no condition set is applied in place of the deleted condition set. Can accept: ConditionSet or String. (Optional)

method.name: redefine
method.shortdesc: Redefine a condition set with the currently existing conditions and visibilities.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the ConditionSet.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
